findings.reason: The 2026-08-25 run swept forward from the last tracked id (2608.20852) using the full, unfiltered arxiv.org/list/cs.RO/recent listing (title-by-title, not a 'humanoid' keyword search) and, in the course of spot-checking ambiguous bipedal-sounding titles, found arXiv 2608.19955 'MILD: Tractable Terrain Modeling for Learning Improved Bipedal Locomotion on Deformable Surfaces' - a paper validated on the EngineAI SA01 humanoid platform that was verified in-scope and added to Locomotion. Its title contains neither 'humanoid' nor any robot brand name, only 'bipedal', and its arXiv id (2608.19955) falls inside the 2608.00500..2608.20087 window that the 2026-08-22 AM run already reported as fully covered using an arXiv 'humanoid' keyword search - meaning that keyword search missed it. This indicates prior and possibly future keyword-only 'humanoid' searches can systematically miss in-scope papers that describe themselves as 'bipedal' (or other non-'humanoid' phrasing) without the word 'humanoid' in the title. A full-listing title scan (not just a keyword search) is more reliable but far more expensive over a multi-month window. This run only did a full-listing scan of two windows, not the entire historical range: (1) arxiv.org/list/cs.RO/recent, covering roughly 2608.19661..2608.21358 (2026-08-19..2026-08-24), and (2) one page of arxiv.org/list/cs.RO/2026-08?skip=300&show=250, covering roughly 2608.09112..2608.13396 (2026-08-05..2026-08-11) - the page was requested at 250 entries but the fetch tool's summary was truncated partway through, so even that window was not exhaustively confirmed title-by-title. The range roughly 2608.13397..2608.19660 (approx. 2026-08-12..2026-08-18) and all of July 2026 were NOT full-listing re-scanned this run and rely only on the earlier keyword-search coverage recorded above. A human (or a future run with a larger time budget) should run a full-listing (not keyword-only) resweep of the remaining July-August 2026 cs.RO range to check for other 'humanoid'-keyword-blind entries.
